verdict.rationale: Canny's own changelog product page says it lets teams announce shipped features and close the loop with customers who gave feedback, and it presents itself as dedicated changelog and release-notes software. The evidence is marketing-level only, with no detail on how publishing or customer notification works. Missing for 10: documentation of publishing mechanics (editor, scheduling, notifying voters or linking posts to feedback) and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a product-manager, I can publish a changelog announcing shipped features to close the loop with customers

citations.quote: Announce what you shipped, show customers you heard them, and turn closed feedback into retention and upgrades.
Product Changelog Software and Release Notes Tool
